text:
```yaml
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Free Pascal
      uses: joaopauloschuler/setup-fpc@master
      with:
        version: '3.0.4'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev

    - name: Build tests
      run: fpc tests/RunTests.lpr

    - name: Run tests
      run: ./tests/RunTests
```
